caption_note: Material treatment MISSING: painted in gothic_stone -- the LAST house family with nobody in it. Every pack after this shares pixels or waits.

lamps.why: the brazier, and it is IN THE ROOM rather than on a wall -- the only light in seven packs the player could walk around, so it throws from a place you can stand beside
cold daylight through the arch, so the brazier has something to be warm against
a high cold wash down the aqueduct wall, so the corbels cast and the break reads

place.why: on the opening; the pointed springers sit ABOVE the square head, which is how a real wall carries one under the other
clear of the approach; the half-arch springs into the room
and the opposite pier springs the same way, because two buttresses leaning at each other carry nothing
the channel runs along the wall and stops; the corbels carry on past where it ended
batch043's wall-switch contract: beside the door, at hand height -- the same place as T01-T06's
standing in the room, walkable-around. No other pack's light can be.
under the break in the channel, which is where an arch that fell would land
